## Connection configuration

Secret fields should be given as a reference, `<field>_ref`, such as `env://NAME`, rather than a literal.

| Key | Secret |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | no |
| `auth_header` | no |
| `token_ref` | no |
| `token` | yes; prefer `token_ref` |

## Default role templates

Offered when a source is created with default roles. Edit them to fit.

### `blocked`

| Effect | Action | Resource type | Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|
| deny | `*` | `*` | `*` |

|---|---|---|---|
| allow | `*` | `*` | `*` |

### `read`

| Effect | Action | Resource type | Pattern |

| allow | `http.get` | `http.path` | `/*` |
| allow | `http.head` | `http.path` | `/*` |
